etf.name: She-Economy ETF Token
etf.description: A token tracking a basket of publicly listed companies meeting verified women's rights criteria. NAV updates daily. Rebalances quarterly with WEI updates.

mandatory: Listed on NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, TSX, ASX, Euronext, or SGX
Female board members ≥ 30% (verified from public filings)
Headquartered in WRBCS PREFERRED or ACCEPTABLE country
No material ESG controversies in last 24 months
at_least_one_of: Equal Pay International Coalition certified employer

exclusion_criteria: Headquarters in WRBCS AVOID or EMBARGO country
Primary revenue from AVOID country without WRTC certification

sector_targets.Consumer Goods: 15% — fair trade, B Corp, ethical supply chain

nav_mechanics.update_frequency: Daily — from exchange price feeds via Chainlink
nav_mechanics.rebalancing: Quarterly — aligned with WEI score publications
nav_mechanics.rebalancing_trigger: WEI score change OR WRBCS rating change for any basket member
nav_mechanics.exit_trigger: Company drops below criteria → automatic replacement
nav_mechanics.wei_link: 30% of rebalancing weight given to companies whose headquarter country shows WEI improvement. Companies in PREFERRED countries get +5% tilt.

token_mechanics.backing: Each token = fractional ownership of basket
token_mechanics.mint: Investor deposits ETH/USDC → receives SHEETF at NAV
token_mechanics.redeem: Burn SHEETF → receive underlying basket value
token_mechanics.protocol: Synthetix or Set Protocol for basket management

etf.performance_thesis: Research from McKinsey, MSCI, and Harvard shows companies with gender-diverse leadership outperform peers by 15-25% over 5-year horizons. The She-Economy ETF captures this 'gender alpha' while directly incentivising women's rights progress.
